why: A few framework-bound leaves are imported by lib, the shell and several routes (series, chart-state, usage accounts, the calendar derive and query). They port once, first, so nothing imports a later Issue.
what: lib/series, lib/chart-state, usage-tracking/accounts and the calendar derive plus query, with tests, on the v3 token and chart APIs. Per-feature model.ts and types.ts are not here: each route Issue ports its own.
contract: Read basalt-ui docs/v3/concepts/migration-release.md 6.1-6.3, argo DESIGN.md and the managed layer (.claude/rules/basalt-v3-*.md, skills basalt-v3-*). The installed basalt-ui is exact 3.0.0-next.N: its docs/recipes and llms.txt are the API truth. Never import apps/dashboard; share through @argo/shared. Order: shared, state-features, state-stores, queries, shell, routes; a later Issue's import is a signal, never a stub. `basalt-ui/tokens` and `./format` do not exist in v3 (ARCHITECTURE.md section 3): accounts.ts and series.ts read tokens through the installed docs.
exemplar: Old apps/dashboard/src/{lib/series.ts,lib/chart-state.ts,lib/queries/calendar.ts,features/calendar/derive.ts,features/usage-tracking/accounts.ts} and their tests. v3 chart law: series are discriminated by mark and phase (docs/v3/concepts/charts-cards-kanban.md).
change: Copy each file with its test into the same relative path in dashboard-v3 and retarget imports to @argo/shared and the v3 APIs: series definitions for mark and phase, `unwrap` from basalt-ui/data in queries/calendar.ts, a local ScheduleEventData type in place of the @mantine/schedule one, tokens through the v3 route. Rule: the app preset forbids @mantine and basalt-ui/legacy here. Skill snippet: none.
commits: Argo ships by push to master: conventional, one concern each, no attribution. Never edit node_modules or basalt-ui; a gap is a `friction:` line in the PR body, worked around in app code.
proof: Unit tests only; no rendered surface.
acceptance: `bun --cwd apps/dashboard-v3 test src/lib src/features/calendar src/features/usage-tracking` exits 0
`bun scripts/check-test-port.ts apps/dashboard/src/lib apps/dashboard-v3/src/lib --only '{series,chart-state}*'` exits 0 for the files owned here (marked `// port:` lines listed in the PR)
chart-state and series tests assert the same palette and series-identity laws as the old tests
out_of_scope: Components, routes, stores, the other queries, CSS.
